reports.title: Alpha Tau Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update

desk.period: Nine months to 30 Sep 2026 (Q3 2026 report; no separate quarter figures given)
desk.headline: Nine-month loss widens to $98.9m ($1.09 a share) on warrant revaluation; cash $99.8m; no financial guidance
results: Alpha Tau reported nine-month figures only: a net loss of $98.9m ($1.09 a share) against $30.5m ($0.39) a year earlier.
Most of the jump was a $58.5m financial expense from revaluing warrants as the share price rose; the warrant liability stood at $66.0m.
R&D spending rose to $31.7m on staff costs, more trial activity and raw materials; the operating loss was $40.2m.
Cash, deposits and restricted deposits rose to $99.8m from $76.9m at the end of 2025.
In its brain-cancer (REGAIN) trial all eight treated patients were alive, and five of six assessed had complete responses; the FDA allowed the trial to grow to up to 20 patients.

guidance.summary: Alpha Tau has no product revenue and gives no financial guidance. It expects pivotal skin-cancer (ReSTART) results and more REGAIN data in Q1 2027, first pancreatic (IMPACT) data in H1 2027, and its New Hampshire plant to be ready for trial supply by end-2026.

watch: Top-line ReSTART pivotal results in Q1 2027 and a possible FDA submission.
Further REGAIN data in Q1 2027 and first IMPACT pancreatic data in H1 2027.
Cash use against the $99.8m balance and further swings in the warrant liability.
